question: Where will India's first home for transgender children in need of care and protection soon be established?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Bengaluru.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **In Bengaluru,** the nation's** first homes for transgender youngsters** in need of care and safety will shortly be built.
 
• The project was approved by the** Ministry of Women and Child Development.**
 
• In** Bengaluru Urban, two such government-run facilities **would be built.
 
• It would be set aside for** transgender kids **who need care and protection, such as **orphans, abandoned kids, street kids, slum kids, and kid abuse victims.**
 
• The** two transgender homes** would have the capacity to accommodate **50 children each.**
